name: FPI net equity investment (month to date)
description: Foreign portfolio investors' net investment in Indian equities so far this month, from NSDL depository data. It includes stock-exchange trades and primary-market investments such as IPOs, so it can differ from reports that count stock-exchange trades only.
source: NSDL, daily trends in FPI investment
releaseSchedule: NSDL reports FPI investment daily, a day after trading. Updated automatically.
